title: THE KILL FEED SHOWS EVERY KILL NEARBY
why: His answer 35: the kill feed should show everything nearby. It only ever told a party about its own kills, and only in a party window, so a solo raid had no feed at all. Now every body that dies within about 1,100 units of you is a line on the right edge, in a solo raid and in a party. Your own kill reads YOU killed and the name, as the party feed always has; a kill by anyone else reads in the words of the floating label, such as SKAV ELIMINATED or SENTRY DESTROYED, with ELITE in front of an elite. In a party the host tells the other window of a kill nobody in the party made. It keeps four lines at most, as before, and nothing about damage, kills or scores moves.
now: The kill feed now shows every kill near you, in a solo raid as well as a party.
